newsitem.title: USA: Beverly Enterprises unit's suit to proceed.
newsitem.headline: Beverly Enterprises unit's suit to proceed.

text.p: Beverly Health and Rehabilitation Services Inc on Wednesday said a judge cleared the way for its defamation suit to proceed against the Service Employees International Union.

Martin Linsky, an administrative law judge for the National Labor Relations Board, ruled against a filing by three locals of the union that charged the company with unfair labor practices, Beverly Health said.
In doing so, Linsky concluded that Beverly Health had a reasonable basis to proceed with its defamation suit, the company said in a statement.
Beverly Health is charging the unions with falsely impugning the company's business practices and attempting to manipulate the media to promote defamatory information.
Beverly Health is the core business unit of Beverly Enterprises Inc, which operates nursing and retirement health centers.
Beverly Health said it was seeking compensatory damages, legal costs and punitive damages in its suit, but it did not specify an amount.
